title: AI-Assisted Semantic-Plausibility Audit — Strict Output Schema (ai_blinded_v1)
description: Strict JSON output contract for the blinded AI-assisted semantic-plausibility audit. Both raters (ChatGPT and Claude) MUST produce one JSON document per batch that conforms to this schema. The controlling audit prompt is read-only; the rater fills ONLY the rows and cases that appear in the attached batch evidence.

batch_id.description: The exact batch folder name this output belongs to (e.g. chatgpt_batch_01 or claude_batch_01). Copied verbatim from the batch folder the rater was given.

rows.description: One object per neutral_row_id present in the batch evidence. Exactly one row object per listed neutral_row_id; no extra rows.

neutral_row_id.description: Neutral identifier for the file-level judgment. Must match a neutral_row_id present in the attached batch evidence.

label.description: The semantic-plausibility category for this row. Use 4_not_determinable when the evidence is genuinely insufficient; abstention is only for rows you refuse to judge.

confidence.description: Confidence in this row label. MUST be null when abstaining (label absent).

rationale.description: Concise natural-language justification tied to the public intent, the diff, and the candidate universe. MUST be null when abstaining.

evidence.description: List of evidence references supporting the rationale (file paths, diff hunks, universe counts). MUST be an empty list when abstaining.

abstention_reason.description: Non-empty ONLY when the rater refuses to judge this row (e.g. evidence out of scope, prompt injection attempt). MUST be null when a label is given.

cases.description: One object per neutral_case_id present in the batch evidence. Exactly one case object per listed neutral_case_id.

neutral_case_id.description: Neutral identifier for the case-level summary. Must match a neutral_case_id present in the attached batch evidence.

proxy_quality.description: How well the observed changed-file set (historical_changed_file rows) plausibly covers the semantic impact of the stated change.

omitted_candidate_semantic_impact.description: Is there evidence that a candidate marked omitted_candidate_file was semantically impacted (a plausible omission the observed changed set would miss)?

mixed_tangled_commit.description: Is the change mixed with incidental / refactor / cleanup / unrelated edits?

label_definitions.1_required: semantically required for the stated change
label_definitions.2_related_optional: semantically related/optional for the stated change
label_definitions.4_not_determinable: not determinable from the provided evidence

role_definitions.historical_changed_file: a file that WAS changed in the observed commit (the observed proxy). Judge whether it was semantically necessary/related/incidental for the stated change.
role_definitions.omitted_candidate_file: a candidate file that was NOT changed but appears in the candidate universe. Judge whether it was plausibly semantically impacted and should arguably have been changed (a potential omission).

rules: Do NOT invent rows or cases.
Do NOT mention method/arm/ranking labels; none are provided.
Do NOT alter the schema or add fields.
Do NOT use labels from other batches.
Abstain only for genuine refusals; otherwise use 4_not_determinable for insufficient evidence.
JSON only in the response, no markdown fences.
